plaatsen.tekst: The same shall drink of the wine of the wrath of God, which is poured out without mixture into the cup of his indignation; and he shall be tormented with fire and brimstone in the presence of the holy angels, and in the presence of the Lamb:
Reward her even as she rewarded you, and double unto her double according to her works: in the cup which she hath filled fill to her double.
